title: Nonlocal-to-local variational limits of energies on partitions
summary: We study, through a $Γ$-convergence procedure, the asymptotic behaviour of a general class of nonlocal energies defined on functions taking values in a finite set $Y=\{y_1,\dots,y_N\}\subset\mathbb R^m$. These energies are written in terms of double integrals accounting for pairwise interactions in an open set $Ω$, weighted by a kernel $K_\varepsilon$. If the latter is controlled from above and below by suitable non-negative radial kernels with unit mass concentrating at the origin, then, up to subsequences, the $Γ$-limit has domain $BV(Ω;Y)$ and is given by a local surface energy.
